Mr. Benno WOLF, German Jew, born at Wiesbaden -- --
25, 1904. Holds German Passport J. 16/W
issued in Wiesbaden, expired on January
20, 1940.
Bookkeeper by profession. Is also said
to be an expert in sowing of grain.
Speaks good English and good French.
Arrived in Shanghai on May 22, 1939 in
s.s. Victoria from Europe. Has very
little financial means. Lives in poor
circumstances in a small room at house 18,
611 Dalny Road. Is at present unemployed.

Mrs. Marta WOLF, wife of above, German Jewess, born at
Eschwege on February 20, 1898. Holds
German passport J. No. 104/35 - date and
place of issue unknown - expires on October
30, 1940.
Speaks little English, no fixed profession,
but has a good knowledge of fancy bakery.
Arrived in Shanghai with her husband in the
s.s. Victoria on May 22, 1939 and is at
present living with him in humble circum-
stances at the address indicated higher.

Upon arrival in Shanghai both of the above
were dependent on the Jewish Aid Committee
for sustenance and for some time they resided
in the Kinchow Road Refugee Camp. In January
1940 they removed to 21/945 East Yuhang Road,
while on June 27 they shifted their quarters
to their present abode.

Benno WOLF 先生，德籍犹太人，1904年-- --25日生于威斯巴登（Wiesbaden）。持有在威斯巴登签发的德国护照 J. 16/W 号，已于1940年1月20日过期。
职业为簿记员。据称也是谷物播种专家。
英语和法语均流利。
于1939年5月22日乘“维多利亚”号轮船（s.s. Victoria）从欧洲抵达上海。资财甚微。现居住在大连路611弄18号的一间小房间内，生活贫困。目前失业。

Marta WOLF 夫人，上述人士之妻，德籍犹太女性，1898年2月20日生于埃施韦格（Eschwege）。持有德国护照 J. 104/35 号——签发日期及地点不详——将于1940年10月30日过期。
略通英语，无固定职业，但精通花式面包制作。
于1939年5月22日与其丈夫同乘“维多利亚”号轮船抵达上海，目前与其丈夫在上述地址过着清贫的生活。

上述二人抵沪之初，生计依赖犹太援助委员会，并曾在锦州路难民营居住一段时间。1940年1月，他们迁至余杭路东段945弄21号，随后于6月27日搬至现址。
